$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
if ($MyRow[0] === null) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(reasoncode),0)+1 FROM holdreasons");
	$CodeRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasondescription'), array('On stop'), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array($CodeRow[0], 'On stop', 1));
	$StopCode = $CodeRow[0];
} else {
	$StopCode = $MyRow[0];
}
NewConfigValue('CreditStopReason', $StopCode);
$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices=2");
$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
if ($MyRow[0] == 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(reasoncode),0)+1 FROM holdreasons");
	$CodeRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasondescription'), array('Watch'), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array($CodeRow[0], 'Watch', 2));
}

// Three reminder stages to start with - Finance can change the number, timing and wording
InsertRecord('dunninglevels', array('levelno'), array(1), array('levelno', 'levelname', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'bodytext'),
	array(1, 'First reminder', 30, 'Payment reminder - {CustomerName}',
	"Dear {CustomerName},\n\nOur records show that the following items on your account {CustomerCode} are now overdue. The total overdue is {Currency} {OverdueAmount}.\n\n{InvoiceList}\n\nIf you have already paid, thank you and please ignore this letter. Otherwise we would be grateful if you could arrange payment as soon as possible.\n\nYours sincerely\n\nCredit Control\n{CompanyName}\n{CompanyPhone} {CompanyEmail}"));
InsertRecord('dunninglevels', array('levelno'), array(2), array('levelno', 'levelname', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'bodytext'),
	array(2, 'Second reminder', 60, 'Second reminder - overdue account {CustomerCode}',
	"Dear {CustomerName},\n\nDespite our earlier reminder the following items on your account {CustomerCode} remain unpaid. The total overdue is {Currency} {OverdueAmount}.\n\n{InvoiceList}\n\nPlease arrange payment immediately, or contact us today if there is a reason why these items have not been paid.\n\nYours sincerely\n\nCredit Control\n{CompanyName}\n{CompanyPhone} {CompanyEmail}"));
InsertRecord('dunninglevels', array('levelno'), array(3), array('levelno', 'levelname', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'bodytext'),
	array(3, 'Final notice', 90, 'FINAL NOTICE - account {CustomerCode}',
	"Dear {CustomerName},\n\nFINAL NOTICE\n\nThe following items on your account {CustomerCode} are seriously overdue. The total overdue is {Currency} {OverdueAmount}.\n\n{InvoiceList}\n\nUnless payment is received within 7 days your account will be put on stop and no further goods will be supplied. Interest and late payment fees will be charged on overdue balances in accordance with our terms and conditions.\n\nYours sincerely\n\nCredit Control\n{CompanyName}\n{CompanyPhone} {CompanyEmail}"));

// Every existing customer gets a next review date (BR-40) - Finance can load their own dates with Z_ImportCreditStatus.php
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) WHERE nextreviewdate IS NULL");

if ($_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0) {
	UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control: reviews, stop and watch, credit holds, reminders, interest and fees, write-offs'));
}

<?php

/* Credit control functions.
 *
 * Shared by the credit control scripts, sales order entry, invoicing, the recurring order and EDI order processes
 * and the API. None of these functions start or commit a database transaction - the calling script is responsible
 * for wrapping them in DB_Txn_Begin()/DB_Txn_Commit() so that the credit control records, the customer record and
 * the general ledger are always written together.
 *
 * The credit status of a customer is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, the meaning of which is defined by
 * holdreasons.dissallowinvoices:
 *    0 = normal - trade freely
 *    1 = on stop - no new orders, no dispatch/invoicing of existing orders unless released by credit control
 *    2 = watch - trade, but warn whoever takes an order and list the orders for credit control
 *
 * salesorders.credithold records why an order is held:
 *    0 = not held (or released by credit control)
 *    1 = held because the customer is on stop
 *    2 = held because the order took the customer over their credit limit
 */

/* Transaction types used by credit control - see systypes */
define('CC_TYPE_INTEREST', 13);
define('CC_TYPE_FEE', 14);
define('CC_TYPE_WAIVER', 45);
define('CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 46);
define('CC_TYPE_RECOVERY', 47);

/* Returns a configuration value, from the session if it has been loaded, otherwise straight from the config table
 * (the API and cron processes do not always have the full configuration loaded) */
function CreditControlConfig($ConfName, $Default = '') {
	if (isset($_SESSION[$ConfName])) {
		return $_SESSION[$ConfName];
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT confvalue FROM config WHERE confname='" . $ConfName . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return $Default;
}

function CreditControlUserID() {
	if (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) and $_SESSION['UserID'] != '') {
		return $_SESSION['UserID'];
	}
	return 'system';
}

/* Credit controller, deputy and Finance Director: may change credit status and limits, release held orders,
 * run reminders and charges and request write-offs. The token is configurable through Page Security Settings
 * via the pseudo script CreditControlAuthority. */
function HasCreditControlAuthority() {
	if (!isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])) {
		return false;
	}
	$Token = isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlAuthority']) ? $_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlAuthority'] : 21;
	return in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Finance Director: may approve write-offs above the approval limit (pseudo script WriteOffApproval) */
function HasWriteOffApprovalAuthority() {
	if (!isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])) {
		return false;
	}
	$Token = isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['WriteOffApproval']) ? $_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['WriteOffApproval'] : 22;
	return in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* The customer code a customer log on is set up for - read from the user record rather than the session because
 * other scripts overwrite $_SESSION['CustomerID'] from the query string */
function GetLoggedInCustomer() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT customerid FROM www_users WHERE userid='" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* Returns true if the current user may see the credit information of this customer:
 * customer log ons see only their own account, salesperson log ons only customers with a branch they look after */
function CustomerVisibleToUser($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1) {
		return ($DebtorNo == GetLoggedInCustomer());
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
							AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return ($MyRow[0] > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* SQL condition restricting a customer list to the salesperson's own customers when logged on as a salesperson */
function SalesmanCustomerFilterSQL($DebtorNoField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $DebtorNoField . " IN (SELECT custbranch.debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

		case 2:
			return __('Watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

function CreditHoldDescription($CreditHold) {
	switch ($CreditHold) {
		case 1:
			return __('Credit hold - customer on stop');
		case 2:

}

/* The audit trail of everything credit control does to a customer (BR-32) */
function LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Narrative, $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0, $OrderNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno,
										eventdate,
										userid,
										eventtype,
										narrative,
										oldvalue,
										newvalue,
										transtype,
										transno,
										orderno)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										NOW(),
										'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
										'" . $EventType . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 1000)) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($OldValue, 0, 100)) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($NewValue, 0, 100)) . "',
										'" . (int)$TransType . "',
										'" . (int)$TransNo . "',
										'" . (int)$OrderNo . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit control history record could not be inserted because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
}

/* Returns an array with the credit details of a customer, or false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					debtorsmaster.paymentterms,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
					currencies.decimalplaces,
					currencies.rate,
					paymentterms.terms
				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
				INNER JOIN paymentterms
					ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Details = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Details['balance'] = $MyRow[0];

	$Overdue = 0;
	foreach (GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, date('Y-m-d'), 1, false, true) as $Item) {
		$Overdue += $Item['balance'];
	}
	$Details['overdue'] = min($Overdue, max($Details['balance'], 0));

	/* The reason recorded with the latest change of credit status */
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT narrative, eventdate, userid
						FROM creditcontrollog
						WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND eventtype='Status'
						ORDER BY id DESC
						LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$Details['statusreason'] = $MyRow['narrative'];
		$Details['statusdate'] = $MyRow['eventdate'];
		$Details['statususer'] = $MyRow['userid'];
	} else {
		$Details['statusreason'] = '';
		$Details['statusdate'] = '';
		$Details['statususer'] = '';
	}
	return $Details;
}

function CustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return ($MyRow[0] == 1);
}

/* Shows a prominent message about the credit status wherever staff look at a customer or take an order (BR-09).
 * Returns the dissallowinvoices value of the customer's status. */
function ShowCreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo) {
	global $RootPath;
	$Details = GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo);
	if ($Details === false) {
		return 0;
	}
	$Message = __('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusName($Details['dissallowinvoices']) . ' (' . $Details['reasondescription'] . ')';
	if ($Details['statusreason'] != '') {
		$Message .= ' - ' . $Details['statusreason'];
	}
	$Message .= '. ' . __('Credit limit') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['creditlimit'], 0) . ' ' . $Details['currcode']
			. ', ' . __('balance') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['balance'], $Details['decimalplaces'])
			. ', ' . __('overdue') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['overdue'], $Details['decimalplaces']) . '.';
	if ($Details['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is ON STOP. No orders can be accepted and nothing can be dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases it. Please contact credit control.'), 'error');
	} elseif ($Details['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is ON WATCH. Orders can be taken but credit control will review them. Please discuss with credit control before committing to large orders.'), 'warn');
	} elseif ($Details['creditlimit'] < $Details['balance']) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is over its credit limit.'), 'warn');
	}
	return $Details['dissallowinvoices'];
}

/* The lowest status code of each kind - used for defaults */
function GetDefaultCreditStatus($DissallowInvoices = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MIN(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices='" . (int)$DissallowInvoices . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* The status code used when a customer is put on stop automatically (after a bad debt write-off) */
function GetStopCreditStatus() {
	$Code = CreditControlConfig('CreditStopReason', '');
	if ($Code != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $Code . "' AND dissallowinvoices=1");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return $Code;
		}
	}
	return GetDefaultCreditStatus(1);
}

/* Puts every open order of the customer on credit hold - called when the customer goes on stop so that orders
 * taken before the stop are not dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases them (BR-06) */
function HoldOpenOrdersForStop($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT DISTINCT salesorders.orderno
			FROM salesorders
			INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
				ON salesorders.orderno=salesorderdetails.orderno
			WHERE salesorders.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND salesorders.quotation=0
			AND salesorders.credithold<>1
			AND salesorderdetails.completed=0";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Orders = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Orders[] = $MyRow['orderno'];
	}
	if (count($Orders) > 0) {
		$ErrMsg = __('The open orders of the customer could not be put on credit hold because');
		DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold=1 WHERE orderno IN (" . implode(',', $Orders) . ")", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		foreach ($Orders as $OrderNo) {
			LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'OrderHold', __('Order put on credit hold because the customer was put on stop'), '', CreditHoldDescription(1), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
		}
	}
	return $Orders;
}

/* Changes the credit status of a customer, recording who, when and why (BR-05) */
function SetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$Old = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $NewHoldReason . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$New = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Old['holdreason'] == $NewHoldReason) {
		return true;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $NewHoldReason . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo,
						'Status',
						$Reason,
						$Old['reasondescription'] . ' (' . CreditStatusName($Old['dissallowinvoices']) . ')',
						$New['reasondescription'] . ' (' . CreditStatusName($New['dissallowinvoices']) . ')');
	if ($New['dissallowinvoices'] == 1 and $Old['dissallowinvoices'] != 1) {
		HoldOpenOrdersForStop($DebtorNo);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Changes the credit limit of a customer, recording who, when and why */
function SetCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if (round($MyRow[0], 2) == round($NewLimit, 2)) {
		return;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'Limit', $Reason, locale_number_format($MyRow[0], 0), locale_number_format($NewLimit, 0));
}

/* Records a credit review (BR-01, BR-03, BR-04). The limit and status change are made as part of the review so that
 * the reason is always recorded with them. Returns the review id. */
function RecordCreditReview($DebtorNo, $Outcome, $NewLimit, $NewHoldReason, $Notes, $NextReviewDate) {
	$Details = GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo);
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditreviews (debtorno,
										reviewdate,
										reviewedby,
										outcome,
										oldcreditlimit,
										newcreditlimit,
										oldholdreason,
										newholdreason,
										notes,
										nextreviewdate)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										NOW(),
										'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
										'" . $Outcome . "',
										'" . $Details['creditlimit'] . "',
										'" . $NewLimit . "',
										'" . $Details['holdreason'] . "',
										'" . $NewHoldReason . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string($Notes) . "',
										'" . $NextReviewDate . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit review could not be recorded because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	$ReviewID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('creditreviews', 'reviewid');

	$ReviewReason = __('Credit review') . ' ' . $ReviewID . ' (' . CreditReviewOutcomes()[$Outcome] . ')';
	SetCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $ReviewReason);
	SetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $ReviewReason . ($Notes != '' ? ': ' . $Notes : ''));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate='" . $NextReviewDate . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo,
						'Review',
						CreditReviewOutcomes()[$Outcome] . ($Notes != '' ? ': ' . $Notes : ''),
						(empty($Details['nextreviewdate']) ? '' : ConvertSQLDate($Details['nextreviewdate'])),
						ConvertSQLDate($NextReviewDate),
						0,
						$ReviewID);
	return $ReviewID;
}

function CreditReviewOutcomes() {
	return array('Confirmed' => __('Limit confirmed'),
				'Raised' => __('Limit raised'),
				'Reduced' => __('Limit reduced'),
				'Watch' => __('Put on watch'),
				'Stop' => __('Put on stop'),
				'Normal' => __('Returned to normal'),
				'Other' => __('Other'));
}

/* The next review date for a new customer (BR-02) */
function DefaultNextReviewDate() {
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('m') + (int)CreditControlConfig('CreditReviewMonths', 12), date('d'), date('Y')));
}

/* Value of the uninvoiced part of an order in the customer's currency */
function GetOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unitprice*(quantity-qtyinvoiced)*(1-discountpercent)),0)
						FROM salesorderdetails
						WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'
						AND completed=0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT freightcost FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$FreightRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0] + $FreightRow[0];
}

/* Applies credit control to an order that has just been entered or changed, by any route (BR-06, BR-10):
 * - orders for customers on stop are put on hold
 * - with CheckCreditLimits = 3 orders that take the customer over their credit limit are put on hold
 * $PreviousValue is the value of the order before a modification - an order that has not grown is not re-checked
 * against the limit, so that credit control's release is not undone by changing a delivery address.
 * Returns the hold status of the order. */
function ApplyOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $DebtorNo, $PreviousValue = null) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT quotation, credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$Order = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Order['quotation'] != 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$NewHold = 0;
	if (CustomerOnStop($DebtorNo)) {
		$NewHold = 1;
	} elseif (CreditControlConfig('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 3
		and ($PreviousValue === null or GetOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) > $PreviousValue + 0.005)) {
		/* GetCreditAvailable already takes this order into account as it is now in the database */
		if (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) < 0) {
			$NewHold = 2;
		}
	}
	if ($NewHold != 0 and $NewHold != $Order['credithold']) {
		$ErrMsg = __('The order could not be put on credit hold because');
		DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold='" . $NewHold . "' WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'OrderHold', CreditHoldDescription($NewHold), '', CreditHoldDescription($NewHold), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
		return $NewHold;
	}
	return $Order['credithold'];
}

function GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* Credit control releases a held order so that it can be dispatched and invoiced */
function ReleaseOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['credithold'] == 0) {
		return;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The order could not be released because');
	DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold=0 WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($MyRow['debtorno'], 'OrderRelease', $Reason, CreditHoldDescription($MyRow['credithold']), __('Released'), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans joined to paymentterms - the same rule as the aged debtors report */
function DueDateSQL() {
	return "(CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END)";
}

/* Returns the overdue items of a customer as at a date (Y-m-d): positive outstanding balances whose due date was at
 * least $MinDaysOverdue days before $AsAtDate. Disputed items are excluded unless asked for (BR-18).
 * Late payment interest and fees can be excluded - we do not charge interest on charges. */
function GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $AsAtDate, $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $ExcludeCharges = false, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.ovamount+debtortrans.ovgst+debtortrans.ovfreight+debtortrans.ovdiscount AS total,
					debtortrans.balance,
					systypes.typename,
					" . DueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue,
					CASE WHEN debtortransdisputes.debtortransid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS disputed
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			INNER JOIN currencies
				ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
			INNER JOIN systypes
				ON debtortrans.type=systypes.typeid
			LEFT JOIN debtortransdisputes
				ON debtortrans.id=debtortransdisputes.debtortransid
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND ROUND(debtortrans.balance, currencies.decimalplaces) > 0
			AND debtortrans.trandate<='" . $AsAtDate . "'
			AND DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue;
	if ($ExcludeCharges) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CC_TYPE_INTEREST . "," . CC_TYPE_FEE . ")";
	}
	if (!$IncludeDisputed) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortransdisputes.debtortransid IS NULL";
	}
	$SQL .= " ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Marks or clears the dispute flag on a customer transaction (BR-18) */
function SetTransactionDispute($DebtorTransID, $Disputed, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, type, transno FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Trans = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$ErrMsg = __('The dispute could not be recorded because');
	if ($Disputed) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtortransid FROM debtortransdisputes WHERE debtortransid='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
			return true;
		}
		DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortransdisputes (debtortransid, debtorno, raiseddate, raisedby, reason)
					VALUES ('" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "',
							'" . $Trans['debtorno'] . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($Trans['debtorno'], 'Dispute', $Reason, '', __('Disputed'), $Trans['type'], $Trans['transno']);
	} else {
		DB_query("DELETE FROM debtortransdisputes WHERE debtortransid='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($Trans['debtorno'], 'Dispute', $Reason, __('Disputed'), __('Settled'), $Trans['type'], $Trans['transno']);
	}
	return true;
}

/* The branch, sales person and exchange rate used for credit control transactions raised against a customer */
function GetCustomerPostingDetails($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.salestype,
					currencies.rate,
					currencies.decimalplaces,
					custbranch.branchcode,
					custbranch.salesman
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN currencies
				ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
			INNER JOIN custbranch
				ON debtorsmaster.debtorno=custbranch.debtorno
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
			ORDER BY custbranch.disabletrans, custbranch.branchcode
			LIMIT 1";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Inserts a customer transaction (no tax) and returns its id */
function InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans($Type, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $Posting, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Reference, $Amount, $Rate, $InvText, $Alloc = 0, $DiffOnExch = 0) {
	$Settled = (abs($Amount - $Alloc) < pow(10, -$Posting['decimalplaces']) / 2) ? 1 : 0;
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									settled,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									alloc,
									diffonexch,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
							VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . $DebtorNo . "',
									'" . $Posting['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $Settled . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . $Posting['salestype'] . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . $Alloc . "',
									'" . $DiffOnExch . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($InvText) . "',
									'" . $Posting['salesman'] . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	return DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');
}

function InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	if (round($Amount, 4) == 0) {
		return;
	}
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
								typeno,
								trandate,
								periodno,
								account,
								narrative,
								amount)
						VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
								'" . $TransNo . "',
								'" . $TranDate . "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $Account . "',
								'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
								'" . $Amount . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The general ledger transaction could not be inserted because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
}

/* Allocates a credit (waiver or write-off) against a debit, posting any exchange difference to the general ledger
 * in the same way as CustomerAllocations.php. Returns the exchange difference in home currency. */
function AllocateCreditControlCredit($CreditID, $CreditRate, $DebitID, $Amount, $Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Narrative) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, ovamount+ovgst+ovfreight+ovdiscount AS total, alloc, diffonexch
						FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $DebitID . "'");
	$Debit = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	/* a positive difference is a gain, a negative one a loss - same convention as CustomerAllocations.php */
	$DiffOnExch = ($Amount / $CreditRate) - ($Amount / $Debit['rate']);
	$ErrMsg = __('The allocation could not be recorded because');
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $TranDate . "', '" . $Amount . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $DebitID . "')", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	$NewAlloc = $Debit['alloc'] + $Amount;
	$Settled = (abs($Debit['total'] - $NewAlloc) < 0.005) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "',
					settled='" . $Settled . "',
					diffonexch=diffonexch+" . $DiffOnExch . "
				WHERE id='" . $DebitID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	if (round($DiffOnExch, 4) != 0 and $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' ' . __('difference on exchange'), -$DiffOnExch);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative . ' ' . __('difference on exchange'), $DiffOnExch);
	}
	return $DiffOnExch;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Reminder letters (dunning)
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function GetDunningLevels() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT levelno, levelname, daysoverdue, subject, bodytext FROM dunninglevels ORDER BY levelno");
	$Levels = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Levels[$MyRow['levelno']] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Levels;
}

function GetLastDunningLetter($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT letterid, letterdate, levelno, amount
						FROM dunningletters
						WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
						ORDER BY letterdate DESC, letterid DESC
						LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Email addresses for reminders: the customer contacts flagged to receive statements (the accounts contacts) */
function GetCustomerAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "' AND statement=1");
	$Emails = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress(trim($MyRow['email']))) {
			$Emails[] = trim($MyRow['email']);
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* Works out who should receive which reminder in a run as at $AsAtDate (BR-12, BR-15).
 * A customer receives the next stage only if still overdue and only one stage up from the last letter of the
 * current cycle - the cycle restarts when everything covered by the previous letters has been paid.
 * Returns an array of proposals keyed by debtorno. Customers who are not due a letter are included with
 * 'level' = 0 and a 'note' explaining why, so that credit control can see the whole picture. */
function ProposeDunningRun($AsAtDate, $Salesman = '', $Currency = '') {
	$Levels = GetDunningLevels();
	if (count($Levels) == 0) {
		return array();
	}
	$FirstLevel = reset($Levels);
	$MinDaysBetween = (int)CreditControlConfig('DunningMinDays', 14);

	$SQL = "SELECT DISTINCT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					currencies.decimalplaces,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN debtortrans
				ON debtorsmaster.debtorno=debtortrans.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			INNER JOIN currencies
				ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE ROUND(debtortrans.balance, currencies.decimalplaces) > 0
			AND DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$FirstLevel['daysoverdue'];
	if ($Salesman != '') {
		$SQL .= " AND debtorsmaster.debtorno IN (SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE salesman='" . $Salesman . "')";
	}
	if ($Currency != '') {
		$SQL .= " AND debtorsmaster.currcode='" . $Currency . "'";
	}
	$SQL .= SalesmanCustomerFilterSQL() . " ORDER BY debtorsmaster.debtorno";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);

	$Proposals = array();
	while ($Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items = GetOverdueItems($Customer['debtorno'], $AsAtDate, 1);
		$Proposal = $Customer;
		$Proposal['items'] = $Items;
		$Proposal['level'] = 0;
		$Proposal['note'] = '';
		$Proposal['emails'] = GetCustomerAccountsEmails($Customer['debtorno']);

		$BalResult = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $Customer['debtorno'] . "'");
		$BalRow = DB_fetch_row($BalResult);
		$Overdue = 0;
		$MaxDays = 0;
		$OldestDueDate = '';
		foreach ($Items as $Item) {
			$Overdue += $Item['balance'];
			$MaxDays = max($MaxDays, $Item['daysoverdue']);
			if ($OldestDueDate == '' or $Item['duedate'] < $OldestDueDate) {
				$OldestDueDate = $Item['duedate'];
			}
		}
		$Proposal['amount'] = round(min($Overdue, $BalRow[0]), $Customer['decimalplaces']);
		$Proposal['maxdays'] = $MaxDays;

		$Last = GetLastDunningLetter($Customer['debtorno']);
		$CurrentLevel = 0;
		if ($Last !== false and $OldestDueDate != '' and $Last['letterdate'] >= $OldestDueDate) {
			$CurrentLevel = $Last['levelno'];
		}
		$Proposal['lastletter'] = $Last;
		$Proposal['currentlevel'] = $CurrentLevel;

		$TargetLevel = 0;
		foreach ($Levels as $LevelNo => $Level) {
			if ($MaxDays >= $Level['daysoverdue']) {
				$TargetLevel = $LevelNo;
			}
		}
		/* step up one stage at a time */
		$NextLevel = 0;
		foreach ($Levels as $LevelNo => $Level) {
			if ($LevelNo > $CurrentLevel and $LevelNo <= $TargetLevel) {
				$NextLevel = $LevelNo;
				break;
			}
		}

		if (count($Items) == 0) {
			$Proposal['note'] = __('All overdue items are disputed');
		} elseif ($Proposal['amount'] <= 0) {
			$Proposal['note'] = __('Overdue items are covered by unallocated payments or credits');
		} elseif ($Last !== false and DateDiff(ConvertSQLDate($AsAtDate), ConvertSQLDate($Last['letterdate']), 'd') < $MinDaysBetween) {
			$Proposal['note'] = __('A reminder was sent on') . ' ' . ConvertSQLDate($Last['letterdate']);
		} elseif ($NextLevel == 0) {
			if ($CurrentLevel > 0 and $CurrentLevel == max(array_keys($Levels))) {
				$Proposal['note'] = __('Final notice already sent - credit control to decide on stop');
			} else {
				$Proposal['note'] = __('Not yet overdue enough for the next stage');
			}
		} else {
			$Proposal['level'] = $NextLevel;
			$Proposal['levelname'] = $Levels[$NextLevel]['levelname'];
		}
		$Proposals[$Customer['debtorno']] = $Proposal;
	}
	return $Proposals;
}

/* Fills in the letter wording for a proposal (BR-12, BR-17). Returns array(subject, body). */
function RenderDunningLetter($Level, $Proposal) {
	$Lines = '';
	foreach ($Proposal['items'] as $Item) {
		$Lines .= sprintf("%-22s %-10s %-12s %-12s %5s %15s\n",
						mb_substr(__($Item['typename']), 0, 22),
						$Item['transno'],
						ConvertSQLDate($Item['trandate']),
						ConvertSQLDate($Item['duedate']),
						$Item['daysoverdue'],
						locale_number_format($Item['balance'], $Proposal['decimalplaces']));
	}
	$Table = sprintf("%-22s %-10s %-12s %-12s %5s %15s\n", __('Transaction'), __('Number'), __('Date'), __('Due'), __('Days'), __('Outstanding') . ' ' . $Proposal['currcode'])
			. str_repeat('-', 82) . "\n" . $Lines;
	$Replace = array('{CustomerName}' => $Proposal['name'],
					'{CustomerCode}' => $Proposal['debtorno'],
					'{Currency}' => $Proposal['currcode'],
					'{OverdueAmount}' => locale_number_format($Proposal['amount'], $Proposal['decimalplaces']),
					'{InvoiceList}' => $Table,
					'{Date}' => ConvertSQLDate(date('Y-m-d')),
					'{CompanyName}' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'],
					'{CompanyEmail}' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['email'],
					'{CompanyPhone}' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['telephone']);
	$Subject = strtr($Level['subject'], $Replace);
	$Body = strtr($Level['bodytext'], $Replace);
	if (mb_strpos($Level['bodytext'], '{InvoiceList}') === false) {
		$Body .= "\n\n" . $Table;
	}
	return array($Subject, $Body);
}

/* Records (and emails, if the customer has an accounts email address) a reminder letter (BR-13, BR-16).
 * Returns the letter id. */
function SendDunningLetter($Proposal, $Level) {
	list($Subject, $Body) = RenderDunningLetter($Level, $Proposal);
	$Method = (count($Proposal['emails']) > 0) ? 'E' : 'P';
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO dunningletters (debtorno,
										letterdate,
										levelno,
										currcode,
										amount,
										method,
										emailedto,
										subject,
										lettertext,
										sentby)
								VALUES ('" . $Proposal['debtorno'] . "',
										CURRENT_DATE,
										'" . $Level['levelno'] . "',
										'" . $Proposal['currcode'] . "',
										'" . $Proposal['amount'] . "',
										'" . $Method . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(implode(', ', $Proposal['emails'])) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string($Subject) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string($Body) . "',
										'" . CreditControlUserID() . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The reminder letter could not be recorded because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	$LetterID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('dunningletters', 'letterid');
	foreach ($Proposal['items'] as $Item) {
		DB_query("INSERT INTO dunningletteritems (letterid, debtortransid, type, transno, duedate, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $LetterID . "',
							'" . $Item['id'] . "',
							'" . $Item['type'] . "',
							'" . $Item['transno'] . "',
							'" . $Item['duedate'] . "',
							'" . $Item['balance'] . "')", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	}
	LogCreditControlEvent($Proposal['debtorno'],
						'Reminder',
						$Level['levelname'] . ' - ' . ($Method == 'E' ? __('emailed to') . ' ' . implode(', ', $Proposal['emails']) : __('to be posted')),
						'',
						$Proposal['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Proposal['amount'], $Proposal['decimalplaces']),
						0,
						$LetterID);
	if ($Method == 'E') {
		$From = $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'] . ' <' . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['email'] . '>';
		$Sent = SendEmailFromWebERP($From, $Proposal['emails'], $Subject, $Body, array(), true);
		if ($Sent !== true) {
			DB_query("UPDATE dunningletters SET method='F' WHERE letterid='" . $LetterID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		}
	}
	return $LetterID;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Month end interest and late payment fees
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* Works out the interest and fees for the month ending $PeriodEndDate (Y-m-d) (BR-19 to BR-22).
 * Interest: simple interest at the annual rate on each overdue item (not on interest or fees, not on disputed
 * items) for the days of the month it was overdue.
 * Fee: one flat fee per customer per month, set in the home currency and converted at the current rate. */
function CalculateCreditCharges($PeriodEndDate) {
	$ChargeMonth = mb_substr($PeriodEndDate, 0, 7);
	$MonthStart = $ChargeMonth . '-01';
	$DaysInYear = date('L', strtotime($PeriodEndDate)) ? 366 : 365;
	$InterestRate = (float)CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestRate', 0);
	$InterestDays = (int)CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestDays', 30);
	$Fee = (float)CreditControlConfig('CreditLateFee', 0);
	$FeeDays = (int)CreditControlConfig('CreditFeeDays', 30);
	$MinDays = min($InterestRate > 0 ? $InterestDays : 99999, $Fee > 0 ? $FeeDays : 99999);
	if ($MinDays == 99999) {
		return array();
	}

	$SQL = "SELECT DISTINCT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					currencies.rate,
					currencies.decimalplaces
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN debtortrans
				ON debtorsmaster.debtorno=debtortrans.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			INNER JOIN currencies
				ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
			WHERE ROUND(debtortrans.balance, currencies.decimalplaces) > 0
			AND debtortrans.trandate <= '" . $PeriodEndDate . "'
			AND DATEDIFF('" . $PeriodEndDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") >= " . $MinDays . "
			ORDER BY debtorsmaster.debtorno";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);

	$Charges = array();
	while ($Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Charge = $Customer;
		$Charge['interest'] = 0;
		$Charge['fee'] = 0;
		$Charge['basis'] = 0;
		$Charge['note'] = '';

		$Charged = array();
		$ChargedResult = DB_query("SELECT chargetype FROM creditcharges
									WHERE debtorno='" . $Customer['debtorno'] . "'
									AND chargemonth='" . $ChargeMonth . "'");
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($ChargedResult)) {
			$Charged[$MyRow['chargetype']] = true;
		}

		$BalResult = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $Customer['debtorno'] . "'");
		$BalRow = DB_fetch_row($BalResult);

		$Items = GetOverdueItems($Customer['debtorno'], $PeriodEndDate, $MinDays, true);
		$Overdue = 0;
		$Interest = 0;
		$FeeDue = false;
		foreach ($Items as $Item) {
			$Overdue += $Item['balance'];
			if ($Item['daysoverdue'] >= $InterestDays) {
				/* days of this month the item was overdue */
				$OverdueFrom = max($Item['duedate'], date('Y-m-d', strtotime($MonthStart . ' -1 day')));
				$Days = (strtotime($PeriodEndDate) - strtotime($OverdueFrom)) / 86400;
				$Interest += $Item['balance'] * $InterestRate / 100 * round($Days) / $DaysInYear;
			}
			if ($Item['daysoverdue'] >= $FeeDays) {
				$FeeDue = true;
			}
		}
		/* unallocated payments and credits reduce what is overdue */
		if ($Overdue > 0 and $BalRow[0] < $Overdue) {
			$Factor = max($BalRow[0], 0) / $Overdue;
			$Interest = $Interest * $Factor;
			$Overdue = max($BalRow[0], 0);
			if ($Overdue <= 0) {
				$FeeDue = false;
			}
		}
		$Charge['basis'] = round($Overdue, $Customer['decimalplaces']);

		if ($Customer['interestexempt'] == 1) {
			$Charge['note'] .= __('Exempt from interest') . '. ';
		} elseif (isset($Charged['I'])) {
			$Charge['note'] .= __('Interest already charged for this month') . '. ';
		} elseif ($InterestRate > 0) {
			$Charge['interest'] = round($Interest, $Customer['decimalplaces']);
		}
		if ($Customer['feeexempt'] == 1) {
			$Charge['note'] .= __('Exempt from fees') . '. ';
		} elseif (isset($Charged['F'])) {
			$Charge['note'] .= __('Fee already charged for this month') . '. ';
		} elseif ($Fee > 0 and $FeeDue) {
			$Charge['fee'] = round($Fee * $Customer['rate'], $Customer['decimalplaces']);
		}
		if ($Charge['interest'] > 0 or $Charge['fee'] > 0 or $Charge['note'] != '') {
			$Charges[$Customer['debtorno']] = $Charge;
		}
	}
	return $Charges;
}

/* Posts an interest charge ('I') or late fee ('F') to the customer account and the general ledger (BR-21, BR-23).
 * Returns the transaction number. */
function PostCreditCharge($DebtorNo, $ChargeType, $Amount, $PeriodEndDate, $BasisAmount) {
	$ChargeMonth = mb_substr($PeriodEndDate, 0, 7);
	$Posting = GetCustomerPostingDetails($DebtorNo);
	$Type = ($ChargeType == 'I') ? CC_TYPE_INTEREST : CC_TYPE_FEE;
	$Account = ($ChargeType == 'I') ? CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestAct') : CreditControlConfig('CreditFeeAct');
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($PeriodEndDate));
	$MonthName = MonthAndYearFromSQLDate($PeriodEndDate);
	if ($ChargeType == 'I') {
		$Text = __('Interest on overdue balance for') . ' ' . $MonthName . ' ' . __('at') . ' ' . locale_number_format(CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestRate'), 2) . '% ' . __('per annum');
	} else {
		$Text = __('Late payment fee for') . ' ' . $MonthName;
	}

	$DebtorTransID = InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans($Type, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $Posting, $PeriodEndDate, $PeriodNo, $Text, $Amount, $Posting['rate'], $Text);

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodEndDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text, $Amount / $Posting['rate']);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $PeriodEndDate, $PeriodNo, $Account, $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text, -$Amount / $Posting['rate']);
	}

	/* the unique key on debtorno, chargemonth, chargetype stops the same month being charged twice (BR-22) */
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcharges (debtorno,
									chargemonth,
									chargetype,
									debtortransid,
									transtype,
									transno,
									amount,
									currcode,
									basisamount,
									rate,
									chargedate,
									chargedby)
							VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
									'" . $ChargeMonth . "',
									'" . $ChargeType . "',
									'" . $DebtorTransID . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . $Posting['currcode'] . "',
									'" . $BasisAmount . "',
									'" . ($ChargeType == 'I' ? CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestRate') : 0) . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . CreditControlUserID() . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The charge could not be recorded - it may already have been charged for this month');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'Charge', $Text, '', $Posting['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Amount, $Posting['decimalplaces']), $Type, $TransNo);
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Waives (reverses) a charge with a reason (BR-24). The waiver is a credit at the same exchange rate as the charge,
 * allocated against whatever is still outstanding on the charge. Returns the waiver transaction number. */
function WaiveCreditCharge($ChargeID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditcharges.*,
								debtortrans.rate,
								debtortrans.balance
						FROM creditcharges
						INNER JOIN debtortrans
							ON creditcharges.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
						WHERE creditcharges.chargeid='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'
						AND creditcharges.waived=0");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Charge = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Posting = GetCustomerPostingDetails($Charge['debtorno']);
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(CC_TYPE_WAIVER);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Account = ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'I') ? CreditControlConfig('CreditInterestAct') : CreditControlConfig('CreditFeeAct');
	$Text = __('Waiver of') . ' ' . ($Charge['chargetype'] == 'I' ? __('interest') : __('late payment fee')) . ' ' . $Charge['transno'] . ': ' . $Reason;
	$AllocAmount = min($Charge['amount'], max($Charge['balance'], 0));

	$CreditID = InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans(CC_TYPE_WAIVER, $TransNo, $Charge['debtorno'], $Posting, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, __('Waiver of') . ' ' . $Charge['transno'], -$Charge['amount'], $Charge['rate'], $Text, -$AllocAmount);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_WAIVER, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate']);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_WAIVER, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Charge['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $Charge['amount'] / $Charge['rate']);
	}
	if ($AllocAmount > 0) {
		AllocateCreditControlCredit($CreditID, $Charge['rate'], $Charge['debtortransid'], $AllocAmount, CC_TYPE_WAIVER, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Text);
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The charge could not be marked as waived because');
	DB_query("UPDATE creditcharges
				SET waived=1,
					waivertransno='" . $TransNo . "',
					waivedby='" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
					waiveddate=NOW(),
					waivereason='" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "'
				WHERE chargeid='" . (int)$ChargeID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($Charge['debtorno'], 'Waiver', $Text, $Charge['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Charge['amount'], $Posting['decimalplaces']), '', CC_TYPE_WAIVER, $TransNo);
	return $TransNo;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Bad debt write-off
 * -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/* Home currency value of an amount in the customer's currency at today's rate */
function HomeCurrencyValue($Amount, $CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $Amount / $MyRow[0];
}

/* Records a write-off request. Write-offs with a home currency value above the approval limit wait for the Finance
 * Director (BR-26), the others are posted straight away. $Items is an array of debtortrans id => amount.
 * Returns the write-off id. */
function RequestWriteOff($DebtorNo, $Items, $Reason, $StopCustomer) {
	$Details = GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo);
	$Total = array_sum($Items);
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO writeoffs (debtorno,
									requestdate,
									requestedby,
									amount,
									currcode,
									homeamount,
									reason,
									stopcustomer,
									status)
							VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',

		PostWriteOff($WriteOffID, false);
	}
	return $WriteOffID;
}

/* Checks the items of a write-off are still outstanding - they may have been paid since the request.
 * Returns an error message or '' */
function ValidateWriteOffItems($WriteOffID) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT writeoffitems.amount,
								debtortrans.balance,
								debtortrans.transno,
								systypes.typename
						FROM writeoffitems
						INNER JOIN debtortrans
							ON writeoffitems.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
						INNER JOIN systypes
							ON debtortrans.type=systypes.typeid
						WHERE writeoffitems.writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($MyRow['amount'] > $MyRow['balance'] + 0.005) {
			return __($MyRow['typename']) . ' ' . $MyRow['transno'] . ' ' . __('now only has') . ' ' . locale_number_format($MyRow['balance'], 2) . ' ' . __('outstanding - it has been paid or credited since the write-off was requested');
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* Posts an approved write-off (BR-27): a credit to the customer at today's rate, allocated against the items
 * written off, with the bad debt charged to the bad debt account and the difference on exchange between the
 * invoice rates and today's rate posted to the exchange difference account. Puts the customer on stop if asked
 * (BR-28). */
function PostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $Approved) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT * FROM writeoffs WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "' AND status='P'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Posting = GetCustomerPostingDetails($WriteOff['debtorno']);
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt written off') . ': ' . $WriteOff['reason'];

	$CreditID = InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans(CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo, $WriteOff['debtorno'], $Posting, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, __('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID, -$WriteOff['amount'], $Posting['rate'], $Text, -$WriteOff['amount']);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, CreditControlConfig('BadDebtAct'), $WriteOff['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, $WriteOff['amount'] / $Posting['rate']);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $WriteOff['debtorno'] . ' - ' . $Text, -$WriteOff['amount'] / $Posting['rate']);
	}
	$TotalDiffOnExch = 0;
	$ItemsResult = DB_query("SELECT debtortransid, amount FROM writeoffitems WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	while ($Item = DB_fetch_array($ItemsResult)) {
		$TotalDiffOnExch += AllocateCreditControlCredit($CreditID, $Posting['rate'], $Item['debtortransid'], $Item['amount'], CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $WriteOff['debtorno'] . ' - ' . __('Write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID);
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The write-off could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET diffonexch='" . -$TotalDiffOnExch . "' WHERE id='" . $CreditID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status='A',
					transno='" . $TransNo . "',
					approvedby='" . ($Approved ? CreditControlUserID() : '') . "',
					approveddate=" . ($Approved ? "NOW()" : "NULL") . ",
					posteddate=NOW()
				WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($WriteOff['debtorno'],
						'WriteOff',
						$Text . ($Approved ? ' - ' . __('approved by') . ' ' . CreditControlUserID() : ' - ' . __('within the approval limit')),
						'',
						$WriteOff['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($WriteOff['amount'], $Posting['decimalplaces']),
						CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF,
						$TransNo);
	if ($WriteOff['stopcustomer'] == 1) {
		SetCustomerCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], GetStopCreditStatus(), __('Automatically put on stop following bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

function RejectWriteOff($WriteOffID, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, amount, currcode FROM writeoffs WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "' AND status='P'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$ErrMsg = __('The write-off could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE writeoffs
				SET status='R',
					approvedby='" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
					approveddate=NOW(),
					rejectreason='" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "'
				WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'WriteOff', __('Write-off rejected') . ': ' . $Reason, $WriteOff['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($WriteOff['amount'], 2), '', 0, $WriteOffID);
	return true;
}

/* Reinstates part of a written-off debt when the customer pays it after all (open question 7): a debit to the
 * customer credited back to the bad debt account, against which the receipt is then allocated in the usual way. */
function PostBadDebtRecovery($DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason) {
	$Posting = GetCustomerPostingDetails($DebtorNo);
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(CC_TYPE_RECOVERY);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Text = __('Bad debt recovered') . ': ' . $Reason;
	InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans(CC_TYPE_RECOVERY, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $Posting, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, __('Bad debt recovered'), $Amount, $Posting['rate'], $Text);
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_RECOVERY, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text, $Amount / $Posting['rate']);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans(CC_TYPE_RECOVERY, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, CreditControlConfig('BadDebtAct'), $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text, -$Amount / $Posting['rate']);
	}
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'Recovery', $Text, '', $Posting['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Amount, $Posting['decimalplaces']), CC_TYPE_RECOVERY, $TransNo);
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Checks the general ledger accounts that credit control posts to are set up - returns a list of problems */
function CreditControlGLSetupErrors($Accounts) {
	$Errors = array();
	$Names = array('CreditInterestAct' => __('Interest income account'),
					'CreditFeeAct' => __('Late payment fee income account'),
					'BadDebtAct' => __('Bad debt account'));
	foreach ($Accounts as $ConfName) {
		$Account = CreditControlConfig($ConfName, '');
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT accountcode FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode='" . $Account . "'");
		if ($Account == '' or DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
			$Errors[] = $Names[$ConfName] . ' ' . __('is not set up in the credit control parameters');
		}
	}
	return $Errors;
}
