function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,
								1,
								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

		}

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']==1 AND $StandardCost !=0){

/*first the cost of sales entry - GL accounts are retrieved using the function GetCOGSGLAccount from includes/GetSalesTransGLCodes.php  */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . GetCOGSGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']) . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . ($StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*now the stock entry - this is set to the cost act in the case of a fixed asset disposal */
			$StockGLCode = GetStockGLCode($OrderLineRow['stkcode']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $StockGLCode['stockact'] . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . (-$StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} /* end of if GL and stock integrated and standard cost !=0  and not an asset */

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] !=0){

			//Post sales transaction to GL credit sales
			$SalesGLAccounts = GetSalesGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount )
				VALUES ('10',
					'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $SalesGLAccounts['salesglcode'] . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] . "',
					'" . -$OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "'
				)";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			if ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] !=0){

				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount)
						VALUES (10,
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $SalesGLAccounts['discountglcode'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " @ " . ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * 100) . "%',
							'" . ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['discountpercent']/$OrderHeader['rate']) . "')";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /*end of if discount !=0 */

		} /*end of if sales integrated with gl */

		$LineCounter++; //needed for the array of taxes by line
	} /*end of OrderLine loop */

	$TotalInvLocalCurr = ($TotalFXNetInvoice + $TotalFXTax)/$OrderHeader['rate'];

	if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1){

		/*Now post the tax to the GL at local currency equivalent */
		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $TaxAuthAmount !=0) {

			/*Loop through the tax authorities array to post each total to the taxauth glcode */
			foreach ($TaxTotals as $Tax){
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount )
										VALUES (10,

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

Sales Commission

Overview

A sales commission system which expands the current minimal commission functionality. The system allows for multiple breakpoints with varying rates, to allow for multiple commission records by stock category, area, length of time being a customer, and currency. It automatically creates sales commission accruals, provide reports of sales commissions outstanding, and statements for each sales person, finally creating an invoice to the sales person. The system is easily extendible to allow different methods of commission calculation to be added.

input.content:
Credit Control

Overview

Credit control brings the credit decisions about customers into webERP so that the same rules are applied to every customer every time, no matter how the order arrives, and so that there is a record of what was decided, by whom and when. It covers:

  • credit reviews of customers, with the outcome, notes, a new credit limit and the next review date;
  • putting customers on stop and on watch, and back to normal;
  • holding orders for customers on stop, and orders that would take a customer over their credit limit, until credit control releases them;
  • reminder letters (dunning letters) in escalating stages, sent by email in a weekly run;
  • interest and late payment fees on overdue balances, charged at month end;
  • bad debt write-offs, with approval of larger write-offs;
  • the credit control report, the write-off report and the reconciliation of the customer accounts with the debtors control account;
  • a full credit control history for each customer for the auditors.

Everything credit control does to a customer is recorded in the customer's Credit Control History, shown at the bottom of the Customer Credit Control screen: reviews, status and limit changes, held and released orders, reminders, charges, waivers, disputes, exemptions, notes and write-offs, with the date, time and user. Nothing in the history can be changed or deleted.

Who can do what

Two security tokens control credit control:

  • 21 Credit control - put customers on stop, on watch or back to normal, change credit limits, record reviews, release held orders, run reminders and month end charges, mark disputes, set exemptions, waive charges and request write-offs. Give this token to the role used by the credit controller and the deputy credit controller (and the Finance Director) in Setup - Access Permissions Maintenance.
  • 22 Bad debt write-off approval - approve write-offs above the approval limit. Give this token to the Finance Director's role only.

Both tokens are given to the System Administrator role when the system is upgraded. Which token is needed can be changed in Page Security Settings using the entries CreditControlAuthority and WriteOffApproval.

Sales staff and the sales office can see credit information but cannot change it: in Customer Maintenance the credit limit and credit status are shown but cannot be edited without the credit control token. A user set up for a salesperson only sees the credit information of the customers of their own branches, in the credit control screens and reports as in the rest of webERP. Credit status codes themselves (Setup - Credit Status) can only be maintained with the credit control token.

If both the credit controller and the deputy are away, any user with token 21 can act; the Finance Director should hold it for this reason.

Setting up credit control

Receivables - Maintenance - Credit Control Parameters (Finance, token 10):

  • Standard review period - new customers get a next review date this many months after their account is opened. Shorter periods for higher risk customers are set in their reviews.
  • Credit status used for automatic stop - the status given to a customer when a bad debt is written off.
  • Minimum days between reminders - a customer does not get another reminder letter until this many days after the last one.
  • Interest rate - simple interest, per annum, charged at month end on items more than the set number of days overdue. Zero for no interest. One rate is used for all currencies.
  • Late payment fee - one flat fee per customer per month, set in the home currency and converted to the customer's currency at the exchange rate on the day the charges are run. Zero for no fee.
  • Interest income account, Late payment fee income account and Bad debt account - the general ledger accounts the charges and write-offs post to.
  • Write-offs above this need approval - home currency value above which a write-off waits for the Finance Director. Zero means every write-off needs approval.

Setup - System Parameters - Check Credit Limits must be set to Hold orders for credit control approval for orders over the credit limit to be held. The other settings (do not check, warn, prohibit) work as before.

Setup - Credit Status defines the credit status codes. Each code means one of:

  • Normal - trade normally;
  • Watch - orders are accepted, but whoever takes an order sees a warning with the reason, and the order is listed for credit control;
  • On stop - no new orders by any route, and nothing on existing orders is dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases the order.

The meaning of a code that customers already have cannot be changed - create a new code and move the customers to it, so that each change is recorded against the customer.

Receivables - Maintenance - Reminder Letter Stages (Finance, token 10) sets the number of reminder stages, how many days overdue triggers each stage, and the email subject and wording of each letter. Three stages are set up to start with: a first reminder at 30 days, a second reminder at 60 days and a final notice at 90 days. The wording can use {CustomerName}, {CustomerCode}, {Currency}, {OverdueAmount}, {InvoiceList}, {Date}, {CompanyName}, {CompanyEmail} and {CompanyPhone}. Letters are in English; wording for other languages is not supported yet.

Reminders go to the customer contacts flagged to receive statements (Add a customer contact, Send statement). Credit control should check every customer on account has one before the first run.

Going live

When the system is upgraded every existing customer keeps the credit status and credit limit they have in webERP and is given a next review date twelve months ahead. Open orders of customers who are already on stop are put on credit hold. To load the credit controller's spreadsheet - the stop list, credit limits and review dates - use Receivables - Maintenance - Import Credit Status and Limits. The csv file has one customer per row with the columns: customer code, credit status code, credit limit, next review date (YYYY-MM-DD), reason. Leave a column empty to leave that value unchanged. Run it first with Test run only ticked to check the file. Every change is recorded in the customer's credit control history with the reason from the file.

Customer credit control - reviews, stop and watch

Receivables - Transactions - Customer Credit Control, or Credit Control from the selected customer menu, shows the customer's credit status and the reason for it, credit limit, balance, how much they are over their limit, overdue amount, next review date, last reminder, and exemptions; their outstanding items; the interest and fees charged; their credit reviews; and the full credit control history. Users without the credit control token see all this but cannot change anything.

Recording a credit review

Select the outcome (limit confirmed, raised or reduced, put on watch, put on stop, returned to normal, other), enter the credit limit and credit status after the review, the next review date and notes. The new limit and status take effect immediately and are recorded with the review, so the limit and the reason for it are always together. Reviews cannot be changed or deleted - record a new review instead. The customer drops off the "due for review" list until the next review date.

Putting a customer on stop or watch

Choose the new credit status and give a reason. The reason is shown to staff taking orders for the customer. Putting a customer on stop puts all their open orders on credit hold. Taking a customer off stop does not release those orders automatically - release each one in Orders on Credit Hold.

Disputed items

Mark an invoice as disputed, with the reason, from the list of outstanding items. A disputed item is not included in reminder letters and is not charged interest until the dispute is marked as settled.

Exemptions and notes

Tick Exempt from interest and/or Exempt from late payment fees for key accounts or customers with an agreed payment plan, with the reason. Notes - for example a payment promise, or that a debt has been passed to a collection agency or solicitor - are added to the credit control history.

Orders on credit hold

An order is put on credit hold when:

  • the customer is on stop - an order received electronically (EDI) or a change to an existing order for a customer on stop is kept but held; new orders from the sales office, customer log ons and the web shop are refused; standing (recurring) orders are not raised at all for that period;
  • with Check Credit Limits set to Hold orders for credit control approval, the order takes the customer over their credit limit (outstanding balance plus open orders) - whether entered in the sales office, by a customer log on, through the web shop, by EDI or raised from a standing order. A change that increases a released order is checked again.

An order on credit hold cannot be dispatched or invoiced and is left off picking lists. The sales order list shows Credit Hold instead of the invoice link. Receivables - Transactions - Orders on Credit Hold lists the held orders; credit control releases an order with a reason. The same screen lists the orders taken recently for customers on watch.

Counter sales are invoiced at once, so with orders over the limit held for approval, counter sales that would take a customer over their limit are not allowed.

The reminder letter run

Receivables - Transactions - Reminder Letter Run, normally weekly. Choose the date to work out what is overdue at (normally today), and optionally a salesperson or currency, then Prepare Run. The list shows each customer who will get a reminder, which stage, the overdue amount and items, and where it will be sent. Untick customers to leave out - for example where payment has been promised - and give the reason; it is recorded in their history. Then Send Reminders.

The rules:

  • Only overdue items that are not disputed are included. Unallocated payments and credits reduce the overdue amount; a customer who has paid gets nothing.
  • A customer moves up one stage at a time - the first letter they get is the first stage even if they are already 90 days overdue, and the next stage is sent in a later run if they are still overdue and past the next stage's days.
  • A customer never gets another reminder within the minimum days between reminders.
  • Once everything covered by the earlier letters has been paid, the next overdue item starts again at the first stage.
  • After the final notice the customer is listed as Final notice already sent - credit control to decide on stop. Customers are not put on stop automatically by the reminder run; credit control decides.

Letters are emailed in the customer's currency, listing the overdue items. Customers without an accounts contact email address, and any email that could not be sent, are listed at the end of the run with links to print the letters for posting. Every letter is recorded against the customer with the date, stage, items and amount, can be printed again exactly as sent, and is shown in the customer's history and in the customer portal.

Month end interest and late payment fees

Receivables - Transactions - Month End Interest and Late Payment Fees. Choose the month end and Prepare Charges. The list shows, for each customer, the overdue balance, the interest and the fee in the customer's currency, the home currency total, and any notes (exempt, already charged this month). Untick any customer who should not be charged and Confirm and Post Charges.

  • Interest is simple interest at the annual rate on each overdue item for the days of the month it was overdue. Interest is not charged on earlier interest or fees, nor on disputed items.
  • The fee is one flat fee per customer per month, for customers with an item more than the set number of days overdue.
  • Each charge is a separate transaction - Late Payment Interest or Late Payment Fee - on the customer's account dated the month end, and appears as a separate item on the next statement. It is posted to the debtors control account and the income account set in the parameters.
  • A month can only be charged once to each customer for each type of charge - running the charges again for the same month charges nobody twice.
  • No tax is charged on interest or fees.

To waive a charge, find it on the customer's credit control screen, give the reason and click Waive. A Credit Charge Waiver is posted to the customer's account, allocated against the charge, and reversed out of the income account.

Bad debt write-off

Receivables - Transactions - Bad Debt Write-off. Select the customer, tick the items to write off (all or part of each), give the reason and choose whether to put the customer on stop (ticked unless credit control has decided otherwise). Allocate any unallocated payments or credits before writing off what is left.

  • If the home currency value is not more than the approval limit, the write-off is posted immediately.
  • Otherwise it waits at the top of the same screen until someone with the write-off approval token, who is not the person who requested it, approves or rejects it. Nothing is posted until it is approved. If the items have been paid in the meantime the approval is refused.

A posted write-off is a Bad Debt Write-off transaction on the customer's account at today's exchange rate, allocated against the items written off. The bad debt account is charged at today's rate and the difference from the rates the invoices were raised at is posted to the exchange difference account, so the debtors control account is reduced by exactly what the items were carried at.

If a written-off debt is later paid, use Written-off Debt Paid After All on the same screen to record a Bad Debt Recovery for the amount received (this credits the bad debt account), then enter the receipt and allocate it against the recovery in the usual way.

Reports

Receivables - Reports - Credit Control Report lists customers due or overdue for a credit review, customers over their credit limit (and by how much, largest first), customers on stop and customers on watch, with their salesperson, currency, status, limit, balance, overdue amount, next review date and last reminder. It can be filtered by salesperson and by currency, and totals are shown in the home currency. A salesperson log on only sees their own customers.

Aged Customer Balances now shows each customer's credit status, credit limit and the last reminder stage sent.

Receivables - Reports - Bad Debt Write-off Report lists the write-offs requested in a period, with the customer, amount, reason, who requested it, who approved or rejected it and when it was posted.

Month end reconciliation with the general ledger

Receivables - Reports - Debtors Control Account Reconciliation compares, period by period, the total of the customer accounts in the home currency with the debtors control account, after interest, fees, waivers, write-offs and differences on exchange. If they do not agree, the second table lists every transaction where the customer accounts and the control account differ - usually journals posted directly to the control account, or transactions posted to different periods.

The customer portal

Customers who log in see, under Reminders and Charges on Account, their balance, the reminder letters sent to them (which they can open) and the interest and fees charged, including any waived. A customer only ever sees their own account. Customers on stop are told that their account is on hold and to contact credit control when they try to place an order, in the portal and in the web shop. Customers are never told that they are on watch.

Note for sales staff - watch and stop
  • Watch means credit control is concerned about the customer. You can still take orders. You will see a warning with the reason when you select the customer - talk to the customer about their account before taking large orders. Credit control sees every order taken for customers on watch.
  • On stop means no new orders can be taken for the customer, by you, by the customer in the web shop or portal, by EDI or from standing orders, and nothing already ordered will be picked, dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it. You will see the reason when you select the customer.
  • Over the credit limit - the order is accepted but held until credit control approves it. The order list shows Credit Hold.
  • You can see the credit status, limit, balance, overdue amount and reminders of your own customers in Customer Credit Control and the Credit Control Report, but you cannot change them. Only credit control can change a credit limit or take a customer off stop.
  • Contact the credit controller - or the deputy credit controller when the credit controller is away - about any customer on watch or on stop.

  • Minimum days between reminders - a customer does not get another reminder letter until this many days after the last one.
  • Interest rate - simple interest, per annum, charged at month end on items more than the set number of days overdue. Zero for no interest. One rate is used for all currencies.
  • Late payment fee - one flat fee per customer per month, set in the home currency and converted to the customer's currency at the exchange rate on the day the charges are run. Zero for no fee.
  • Interest income account, Late payment fee income account and Bad debt account - the general ledger accounts the charges and write-offs post to.

  • Watch - orders are accepted, but whoever takes an order sees a warning with the reason, and the order is listed for credit control;
  • On stop - no new orders by any route, and nothing on existing orders is dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases the order.

When the system is upgraded every existing customer keeps the credit status and credit limit they have in webERP and is given a next review date twelve months ahead. Open orders of customers who are already on stop are put on credit hold. The csv file has one customer per row with the columns: customer code, credit status code, credit limit, next review date (YYYY-MM-DD), reason. Leave a column empty to leave that value unchanged. Customer credit control - reviews, stop and watch

Receivables - Transactions - Customer Credit Control, or Credit Control from the selected customer menu, shows the customer's credit status and the reason for it, credit limit, balance, how much they are over their limit, overdue amount, next review date, last reminder, and exemptions; their outstanding items; the interest and fees charged; their credit reviews; and the full credit control history. Users without the credit control token see all this but cannot change anything.

Recording a credit review

Select the outcome (limit confirmed, raised or reduced, put on watch, put on stop, returned to normal, other), enter the credit limit and credit status after the review, the next review date and notes. The new limit and status take effect immediately and are recorded with the review, so the limit and the reason for it are always together. Reviews cannot be changed or deleted - record a new review instead. The customer drops off the "due for review" list until the next review date.

Putting a customer on stop or watch

Choose the new credit status and give a reason. The reason is shown to staff taking orders for the customer. Putting a customer on stop puts all their open orders on credit hold. Taking a customer off stop does not release those orders automatically - release each one in Orders on Credit Hold.

Disputed items

Mark an invoice as disputed, with the reason, from the list of outstanding items. A disputed item is not included in reminder letters and is not charged interest until the dispute is marked as settled.

Exemptions and notes

Tick Exempt from interest and/or Exempt from late payment fees for key accounts or customers with an agreed payment plan, with the reason. Notes - for example a payment promise, or that a debt has been passed to a collection agency or solicitor - are added to the credit control history.

Orders on credit hold

An order is put on credit hold when:

  • the customer is on stop - an order received electronically (EDI) or a change to an existing order for a customer on stop is kept but held; new orders from the sales office, customer log ons and the web shop are refused; standing (recurring) orders are not raised at all for that period;
  • with Check Credit Limits set to Hold orders for credit control approval, the order takes the customer over their credit limit (outstanding balance plus open orders) - whether entered in the sales office, by a customer log on, through the web shop, by EDI or raised from a standing order. A change that increases a released order is checked again.

An order on credit hold cannot be dispatched or invoiced and is left off picking lists. The sales order list shows Credit Hold instead of the invoice link. Receivables - Transactions - Orders on Credit Hold lists the held orders; credit control releases an order with a reason. The same screen lists the orders taken recently for customers on watch.

Counter sales are invoiced at once, so with orders over the limit held for approval, counter sales that would take a customer over their limit are not allowed.

Receivables - Transactions - Reminder Letter Run, normally weekly. Choose the date to work out what is overdue at (normally today), and optionally a salesperson or currency, then Prepare Run. The list shows each customer who will get a reminder, which stage, the overdue amount and items, and where it will be sent. Untick customers to leave out - for example where payment has been promised - and give the reason; it is recorded in their history. Then Send Reminders.

  • Only overdue items that are not disputed are included. Unallocated payments and credits reduce the overdue amount; a customer who has paid gets nothing.
  • A customer moves up one stage at a time - the first letter they get is the first stage even if they are already 90 days overdue, and the next stage is sent in a later run if they are still overdue and past the next stage's days.
  • A customer never gets another reminder within the minimum days between reminders.
  • Once everything covered by the earlier letters has been paid, the next overdue item starts again at the first stage.

  • No tax is charged on interest or fees.

  • Otherwise it waits at the top of the same screen until someone with the write-off approval token, who is not the person who requested it, approves or rejects it. Nothing is posted until it is approved. If the items have been paid in the meantime the approval is refused.

  • On stop means no new orders can be taken for the customer, by you, by the customer in the web shop or portal, by EDI or from standing orders, and nothing already ordered will be picked, dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it.   • You can see the credit status, limit, balance, overdue amount and reminders of your own customers in Customer Credit Control and the Credit Control Report, but you cannot change them. Only credit control can change a credit limit or take a customer off stop.
  • Contact the credit controller - or the deputy credit controller when the credit controller is away - about any customer on watch or on stop.

input.content:
Credit Status Ratings

Each customer has a credit status that describes the risk as assessed by the credit controller. The customer selection screen allows customers to be restricted by their credit status so it is easy to perform inquiries on all the customers with a similar credit status. What each status means for ordering and invoicing is set by the status code - see Credit Control. This is another credit control tool to the credit limit.

Credit Status Ratings can be amended and created from the main menu set up tab from the link labelled Credit Status Maintenance. Only users with the credit control security token can maintain them, and only credit control can change the credit status of a customer.

Status Code

This is any number from 1 to 100. A rating code is required to be held against every customer to identify the credit status of each. The code cannot be changed retrospectively.

Status Description

This field is used in look ups both in the customers amendment/entry and also in the customer selection screen. This is a text field up to 30 characters long. Customers logging in to the portal are never shown the description.

Disallow invoices

The meaning of the status:

  • Normal - invoice OK: trade normally.
  • Watch - warn when taking orders: orders can still be taken and invoiced, but everyone taking an order for the customer is warned, with the reason, and credit control can list the orders taken.
  • On stop - no orders or invoicing: no new orders can be taken by any route and nothing is dispatched or invoiced on existing orders unless credit control releases the order.

The meaning of a status that customers already have cannot be changed - create a new status and move the customers to it through customer credit control, so that each change is recorded with its reason.

# Changelog

All changes details to the webERP project between v4.14.1 and the latest v4 version are documented in this file.
The format is based on [Keep a Changelog], and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning].

For changelogs of v5 and later, please look at the git commit logs for the `master` branch, available at
https://github.com/timschofield/webERP/commits/master/
For changelogs earlier than v4.14.1, please refer to [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md].

For a high-level overview of the main changes, starting with v5, look at [NEWS.md]

## Guidelines
- Keep descriptions as short and concise as possible.
- If including html tags in your description, please surround them with back ticks.
- The commit Type, will typically be one of the following: `Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`
- Enter dates in format yyyy-mm-dd.
- Add links to the associated GitHub commit in Details column.
- Add links to supporting info in Ref column, such as Forum posts, Mailing List archives or GitHub issues.

<?php

/* Credit control functions.
 *
 * Shared by the credit control scripts, sales order entry, invoicing, the recurring order and EDI order processes
 * and the API. None of these functions start or commit a database transaction - the calling script is responsible
 * for wrapping them in DB_Txn_Begin()/DB_Txn_Commit() so that the credit control records, the customer record and
 * the general ledger are always written together.
 *
 * The credit status of a customer is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, the meaning of which is defined by
 * holdreasons.dissallowinvoices:
 *    0 = normal - trade freely
 *    1 = on stop - no new orders, no dispatch/invoicing of existing orders unless released by credit control
 *    2 = watch - trade, but warn whoever takes an order and list the orders for credit control
 *
 * salesorders.credithold records why an order is held:
 *    0 = not held (or released by credit control)
 *    1 = held because the customer is on stop
 *    2 = held because the order took the customer over their credit limit
 */

/* Transaction types used by credit control - see systypes */
define('CC_TYPE_INTEREST', 13);
define('CC_TYPE_FEE', 14);
define('CC_TYPE_WAIVER', 45);
define('CC_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 46);
define('CC_TYPE_RECOVERY', 47);

/* Returns a configuration value, from the session if it has been loaded, otherwise straight from the config table
 * (the API and cron processes do not always have the full configuration loaded) */
function CreditControlConfig($ConfName, $Default = '') {
	if (isset($_SESSION[$ConfName])) {
		return $_SESSION[$ConfName];
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT confvalue FROM config WHERE confname='" . $ConfName . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return $Default;
}

/* Free text from a form - session.php has already escaped it for SQL, but the functions here escape what they
 * store themselves (they also store text built by the system), so undo the SQL escaping to avoid storing it twice */
function CCInput($Value) {
	return stripcslashes(trim($Value));
}

function CreditControlUserID() {
	if (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) and $_SESSION['UserID'] != '') {
		return $_SESSION['UserID'];
	}
	return 'system';
}

/* Credit controller, deputy and Finance Director: may change credit status and limits, release held orders,
 * run reminders and charges and request write-offs. The token is configurable through Page Security Settings
 * via the pseudo script CreditControlAuthority. */
function HasCreditControlAuthority() {
	if (!isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])) {
		return false;
	}
	$Token = isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlAuthority']) ? $_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControlAuthority'] : 21;
	return in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Finance Director: may approve write-offs above the approval limit (pseudo script WriteOffApproval) */
function HasWriteOffApprovalAuthority() {
	if (!isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])) {
		return false;
	}
	$Token = isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['WriteOffApproval']) ? $_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['WriteOffApproval'] : 22;
	return in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* The customer code a customer log on is set up for - read from the user record rather than the session because
 * other scripts overwrite $_SESSION['CustomerID'] from the query string */
function GetLoggedInCustomer() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT customerid FROM www_users WHERE userid='" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* Returns true if the current user may see the credit information of this customer:
 * customer log ons see only their own account, salesperson log ons only customers with a branch they look after */
function CustomerVisibleToUser($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1) {
		return ($DebtorNo == GetLoggedInCustomer());
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
							AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return ($MyRow[0] > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* SQL condition restricting a customer list to the salesperson's own customers when logged on as a salesperson */
function SalesmanCustomerFilterSQL($DebtorNoField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $DebtorNoField . " IN (SELECT custbranch.debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE custbranch.salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

function CreditStatusName($DissallowInvoices) {
	switch ($DissallowInvoices) {
		case 1:
			return __('On Stop');
		case 2:
			return __('Watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

function CreditHoldDescription($CreditHold) {
	switch ($CreditHold) {
		case 1:
			return __('Credit hold - customer on stop');
		case 2:
			return __('Credit hold - over credit limit');
		default:
			return '';
	}
}

/* The audit trail of everything credit control does to a customer (BR-32) */
function LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Narrative, $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0, $OrderNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno,
										eventdate,
										userid,
										eventtype,
										narrative,
										oldvalue,
										newvalue,
										transtype,
										transno,
										orderno)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										NOW(),
										'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
										'" . $EventType . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 1000)) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($OldValue, 0, 100)) . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($NewValue, 0, 100)) . "',
										'" . (int)$TransType . "',
										'" . (int)$TransNo . "',
										'" . (int)$OrderNo . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit control history record could not be inserted because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
}

/* Returns an array with the credit details of a customer, or false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					debtorsmaster.paymentterms,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
					currencies.decimalplaces,
					currencies.rate,
					paymentterms.terms
				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
				INNER JOIN paymentterms
					ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Details = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Details['balance'] = $MyRow[0];

	$Overdue = 0;
	foreach (GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, date('Y-m-d'), 1, false, true) as $Item) {
		$Overdue += $Item['balance'];
	}
	$Details['overdue'] = min($Overdue, max($Details['balance'], 0));

	/* The reason recorded with the latest change of credit status */
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT narrative, eventdate, userid
						FROM creditcontrollog
						WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
						AND eventtype='Status'
						ORDER BY id DESC
						LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$Details['statusreason'] = $MyRow['narrative'];
		$Details['statusdate'] = $MyRow['eventdate'];
		$Details['statususer'] = $MyRow['userid'];
	} else {
		$Details['statusreason'] = '';
		$Details['statusdate'] = '';
		$Details['statususer'] = '';
	}
	return $Details;
}

function CustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return ($MyRow[0] == 1);
}

/* Shows a prominent message about the credit status wherever staff look at a customer or take an order (BR-09).
 * Returns the dissallowinvoices value of the customer's status. */
function ShowCreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo) {
	global $RootPath;
	$Details = GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo);
	if ($Details === false) {
		return 0;
	}
	$Message = __('Credit status') . ': ' . CreditStatusName($Details['dissallowinvoices']) . ' (' . $Details['reasondescription'] . ')';
	if ($Details['statusreason'] != '') {
		$Message .= ' - ' . $Details['statusreason'];
	}
	$Message .= '. ' . __('Credit limit') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['creditlimit'], 0) . ' ' . $Details['currcode']
			. ', ' . __('balance') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['balance'], $Details['decimalplaces'])
			. ', ' . __('overdue') . ': ' . locale_number_format($Details['overdue'], $Details['decimalplaces']) . '.';
	if ($Details['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is ON STOP. No orders can be accepted and nothing can be dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases it. Please contact credit control.'), 'error');
	} elseif ($Details['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is ON WATCH. Orders can be taken but credit control will review them. Please discuss with credit control before committing to large orders.'), 'warn');
	} elseif ($Details['creditlimit'] < $Details['balance']) {
		prnMsg($Message . ' ' . __('This account is over its credit limit.'), 'warn');
	}
	return $Details['dissallowinvoices'];
}

/* The lowest status code of each kind - used for defaults */
function GetDefaultCreditStatus($DissallowInvoices = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT MIN(reasoncode) FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices='" . (int)$DissallowInvoices . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* The status code used when a customer is put on stop automatically (after a bad debt write-off) */
function GetStopCreditStatus() {
	$Code = CreditControlConfig('CreditStopReason', '');
	if ($Code != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $Code . "' AND dissallowinvoices=1");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
			return $Code;
		}
	}
	return GetDefaultCreditStatus(1);
}

/* Puts every open order of the customer on credit hold - called when the customer goes on stop so that orders
 * taken before the stop are not dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases them (BR-06) */
function HoldOpenOrdersForStop($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT DISTINCT salesorders.orderno
			FROM salesorders
			INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
				ON salesorders.orderno=salesorderdetails.orderno
			WHERE salesorders.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND salesorders.quotation=0
			AND salesorders.credithold<>1
			AND salesorderdetails.completed=0";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Orders = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Orders[] = $MyRow['orderno'];
	}
	if (count($Orders) > 0) {
		$ErrMsg = __('The open orders of the customer could not be put on credit hold because');
		DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold=1 WHERE orderno IN (" . implode(',', $Orders) . ")", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		foreach ($Orders as $OrderNo) {
			LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'OrderHold', __('Order put on credit hold because the customer was put on stop'), '', CreditHoldDescription(1), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
		}
	}
	return $Orders;
}

/* Changes the credit status of a customer, recording who, when and why (BR-05) */
function SetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$Old = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $NewHoldReason . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$New = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Old['holdreason'] == $NewHoldReason) {
		return true;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . $NewHoldReason . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo,
						'Status',
						$Reason,
						$Old['reasondescription'] . ' (' . CreditStatusName($Old['dissallowinvoices']) . ')',
						$New['reasondescription'] . ' (' . CreditStatusName($New['dissallowinvoices']) . ')');
	if ($New['dissallowinvoices'] == 1 and $Old['dissallowinvoices'] != 1) {
		HoldOpenOrdersForStop($DebtorNo);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Changes the credit limit of a customer, recording who, when and why */
function SetCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if (round($MyRow[0], 2) == round($NewLimit, 2)) {
		return;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because');
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'Limit', $Reason, locale_number_format($MyRow[0], 0), locale_number_format($NewLimit, 0));
}

/* Records a credit review (BR-01, BR-03, BR-04). The limit and status change are made as part of the review so that
 * the reason is always recorded with them. Returns the review id. */
function RecordCreditReview($DebtorNo, $Outcome, $NewLimit, $NewHoldReason, $Notes, $NextReviewDate) {
	$Details = GetCustomerCreditDetails($DebtorNo);
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditreviews (debtorno,
										reviewdate,
										reviewedby,
										outcome,
										oldcreditlimit,
										newcreditlimit,
										oldholdreason,
										newholdreason,
										notes,
										nextreviewdate)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										NOW(),
										'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
										'" . $Outcome . "',
										'" . $Details['creditlimit'] . "',
										'" . $NewLimit . "',
										'" . $Details['holdreason'] . "',
										'" . $NewHoldReason . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string($Notes) . "',
										'" . $NextReviewDate . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('The credit review could not be recorded because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	$ReviewID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('creditreviews', 'reviewid');

	$ReviewReason = __('Credit review') . ' ' . $ReviewID . ' (' . CreditReviewOutcomes()[$Outcome] . ')';
	SetCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $ReviewReason);
	SetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $ReviewReason . ($Notes != '' ? ': ' . $Notes : ''));
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET nextreviewdate='" . $NextReviewDate . "' WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo,
						'Review',
						CreditReviewOutcomes()[$Outcome] . ($Notes != '' ? ': ' . $Notes : ''),
						(empty($Details['nextreviewdate']) ? '' : ConvertSQLDate($Details['nextreviewdate'])),
						ConvertSQLDate($NextReviewDate),
						0,
						$ReviewID);
	return $ReviewID;
}

function CreditReviewOutcomes() {
	return array('Confirmed' => __('Limit confirmed'),
				'Raised' => __('Limit raised'),
				'Reduced' => __('Limit reduced'),
				'Watch' => __('Put on watch'),
				'Stop' => __('Put on stop'),
				'Normal' => __('Returned to normal'),
				'Other' => __('Other'));
}

/* The next review date for a new customer (BR-02) */
function DefaultNextReviewDate() {
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('m') + (int)CreditControlConfig('CreditReviewMonths', 12), date('d'), date('Y')));
}

/* Value of the uninvoiced part of an order in the customer's currency */
function GetOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unitprice*(quantity-qtyinvoiced)*(1-discountpercent)),0)
						FROM salesorderdetails
						WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'
						AND completed=0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT freightcost FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$FreightRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0] + $FreightRow[0];
}

/* Applies credit control to an order that has just been entered or changed, by any route (BR-06, BR-10):
 * - orders for customers on stop are put on hold
 * - with CheckCreditLimits = 3 orders that take the customer over their credit limit are put on hold
 * $PreviousValue is the value of the order before a modification - an order that has not grown is not re-checked
 * against the limit, so that credit control's release is not undone by changing a delivery address.
 * Returns the hold status of the order. */
function ApplyOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $DebtorNo, $PreviousValue = null) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT quotation, credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$Order = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Order['quotation'] != 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$NewHold = 0;
	if (CustomerOnStop($DebtorNo)) {
		$NewHold = 1;
	} elseif (CreditControlConfig('CheckCreditLimits', 0) == 3
		and ($PreviousValue === null or GetOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) > $PreviousValue + 0.005)) {
		/* GetCreditAvailable already takes this order into account as it is now in the database */
		if (GetCreditAvailable($DebtorNo) < 0) {
			$NewHold = 2;
		}
	}
	if ($NewHold != 0 and $NewHold != $Order['credithold']) {
		$ErrMsg = __('The order could not be put on credit hold because');
		DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold='" . $NewHold . "' WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($DebtorNo, 'OrderHold', CreditHoldDescription($NewHold), '', CreditHoldDescription($NewHold), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
		return $NewHold;
	}
	return $Order['credithold'];
}

function GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return 0;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* Credit control releases a held order so that it can be dispatched and invoiced */
function ReleaseOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, credithold FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['credithold'] == 0) {
		return;
	}
	$ErrMsg = __('The order could not be released because');
	DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET credithold=0 WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	LogCreditControlEvent($MyRow['debtorno'], 'OrderRelease', $Reason, CreditHoldDescription($MyRow['credithold']), __('Released'), 0, 0, $OrderNo);
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans joined to paymentterms - the same rule as the aged debtors report */
function DueDateSQL() {
	return "(CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END)";
}

/* Returns the overdue items of a customer as at a date (Y-m-d): positive outstanding balances whose due date was at
 * least $MinDaysOverdue days before $AsAtDate. Disputed items are excluded unless asked for (BR-18).
 * Late payment interest and fees can be excluded - we do not charge interest on charges. */
function GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $AsAtDate, $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $ExcludeCharges = false, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.ovamount+debtortrans.ovgst+debtortrans.ovfreight+debtortrans.ovdiscount AS total,
					debtortrans.balance,
					systypes.typename,
					" . DueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue,
					CASE WHEN debtortransdisputes.debtortransid IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS disputed
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
			INNER JOIN currencies
				ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
			INNER JOIN systypes
				ON debtortrans.type=systypes.typeid
			LEFT JOIN debtortransdisputes
				ON debtortrans.id=debtortransdisputes.debtortransid
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
			AND ROUND(debtortrans.balance, currencies.decimalplaces) > 0
			AND debtortrans.trandate<='" . $AsAtDate . "'
			AND DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") >= " . (int)$MinDaysOverdue;
	if ($ExcludeCharges) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CC_TYPE_INTEREST . "," . CC_TYPE_FEE . ")";
	}
	if (!$IncludeDisputed) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortransdisputes.debtortransid IS NULL";
	}
	$SQL .= " ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Marks or clears the dispute flag on a customer transaction (BR-18) */
function SetTransactionDispute($DebtorTransID, $Disputed, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, type, transno FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Trans = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$ErrMsg = __('The dispute could not be recorded because');
	if ($Disputed) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtortransid FROM debtortransdisputes WHERE debtortransid='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
			return true;
		}
		DB_query("INSERT INTO debtortransdisputes (debtortransid, debtorno, raiseddate, raisedby, reason)
					VALUES ('" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "',
							'" . $Trans['debtorno'] . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . CreditControlUserID() . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "')", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($Trans['debtorno'], 'Dispute', $Reason, '', __('Disputed'), $Trans['type'], $Trans['transno']);
	} else {
		DB_query("DELETE FROM debtortransdisputes WHERE debtortransid='" . (int)$DebtorTransID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
		LogCreditControlEvent($Trans['debtorno'], 'Dispute', $Reason, __('Disputed'), __('Settled'), $Trans['type'], $Trans['transno']);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Inserts a customer transaction (no tax) and returns its id */
function InsertCreditControlDebtorTrans($Type, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $Posting, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Reference, $Amount, $Rate, $InvText, $Alloc = 0, $DiffOnExch = 0) {
	$Settled = (abs($Amount - $Alloc) < pow(10, -$Posting['decimalplaces']) / 2) ? 1 : 0;
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									settled,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									alloc,
									diffonexch,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
							VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . $DebtorNo . "',
									'" . $Posting['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $Settled . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . $Posting['salestype'] . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . $Alloc . "',
									'" . $DiffOnExch . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($InvText) . "',
									'" . $Posting['salesman'] . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because');
	DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);
	return DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');
}

function InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {

								typeno,

								amount)
						VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
								'" . $TransNo . "',
								'" . $TranDate . "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $Account . "',
								'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
								'" . $Amount . "')";
	$ErrMsg = __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The general ledger transaction could not be inserted because');

}

/* Allocates a credit (waiver or write-off) against a debit, posting any exchange difference to the general ledger
 * in the same way as CustomerAllocations.php. Returns the exchange difference in home currency. */
function AllocateCreditControlCredit($CreditID, $CreditRate, $DebitID, $Amount, $Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Narrative) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate, ovamount+ovgst+ovfreight+ovdiscount AS total, alloc, diffonexch
						FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $DebitID . "'");
	$Debit = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	/* a positive difference is a gain, a negative one a loss - same convention as CustomerAllocations.php */
	$DiffOnExch = ($Amount / $CreditRate) - ($Amount / $Debit['rate']);
	$ErrMsg = __('The allocation could not be recorded because');
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $TranDate . "', '" . $Amount . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $DebitID . "')", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	$NewAlloc = $Debit['alloc'] + $Amount;
	$Settled = (abs($Debit['total'] - $NewAlloc) < 0.005) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "',
					settled='" . $Settled . "',
					diffonexch=diffonexch+" . $DiffOnExch . "
				WHERE id='" . $DebitID . "'", $ErrMsg, '', true);
	if (round($DiffOnExch, 4) != 0 and $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'], $Narrative . ' ' . __('difference on exchange'), -$DiffOnExch);
		InsertCreditControlGLTrans($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative . ' ' . __('difference on exchange'), $DiffOnExch);
	}
	return $DiffOnExch;
}

function GetLastDunningLetter($DebtorNo) {

						FROM dunningletters
						WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
						ORDER BY letterdate DESC, letterid DESC
						LIMIT 1");

/* Email addresses for reminders: the customer contacts flagged to receive statements (the accounts contacts) */

		}
